_doc: Platform D1 migration lock (scripts/ops/check-migration-lock.mjs). Frozen: 0001 to 0005 are deployed to staging and prod, and installs record applied migrations by name only, so an edited pinned file never reaches an existing database. A pinned file never changes: add a new migration, and add its sha256 to the pins in the same PR (CI fails on an unpinned file).
